question: The last subject mentioned in the concurrent list of the Indian Constitution is numbered ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**47**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Concurrent List**, also known as **List III**, is one of the three lists defined in the **Seventh Schedule** of the **Constitution of India**.
 
• The last subject mentioned in the **Concurrent List** is officially numbered as **47**. While the total number of items has increased due to amendments, the numbering still concludes at **47**.
 
• This list contains subjects of common interest to both the **Union Government** and the **State Governments**, allowing both levels of government to legislate on them.
 
• The concept of the **Concurrent List** in the Indian Constitution was borrowed from the **Constitution of Australia**.
